# Ship of Theseus - Full Context

Ship of Theseus is a D3.js visualization tool built by Asif Sayyed. 

## Technical Architecture
- **Frontend:** HTML, CSS, and Vanilla JavaScript
- **Visualization:** D3.js for SVG rendering, stacked area charts, scale conversions (Linear/Log), and view toggling.
- **Data Source:** Pre-processed JSON configurations (`theseus.config.json`) and data files (`data/repo_name.json`) containing code survival matrices over time.

## Philosophy
The project takes its name from the Ship of Theseus paradox: if you replace every line of code over time, is it still the same repository?

## Features
- **Chrono vs Identity Modes:** Switch between a chronological timeline and an identity view to see how code from different years overlaps and survives.
- **Fossil Finder:** Highlights the "Historical Fossil" (the oldest line ever written in the repo) and the "Living Fossil" (the oldest line still present today).
- **Tooltips & Scrubber:** An interactive scrubber that shows the exact breakdown of surviving lines per year at any given point in time.

## Author
Built by Asif Sayyed, a data scientist interested in data visualization and philosophy.
